title: Percussion Musical Instruments
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Show real drums, shakers and jingles. Improvise shakers from bottles and seeds; seal the lid.

skills.key_step: The child names percussion instruments (drums, shakers, jingles, rattles) and says they are played by hitting, shaking or scraping.
steps: Is it hit, shaken or scraped?
contexts: drums at a church or a wedding

misconceptions.repair: Shake a drum (no sound), then hit it.

misconceptions.ask: Is a flute a percussion instrument?
misconceptions.repair: Sort instruments: hit or shake, and blow.

misconceptions.ask: What do you put inside a bottle to make a shaker?
misconceptions.repair: Shake an empty bottle and a bottle of seeds.

misconceptions.ask: Can an instrument be played by scraping?
misconceptions.repair: Scrape a stick along a ridged bottle.

checks.question: Name a percussion instrument.
checks.answer: any of: drum, shaker, jingle, rattle
